description: This file defines the Drupal class 'ChainedFastBackend', which implements a cache backend combining a fast, potentially inconsistent cache with a slower, consistent cache. It manages cache retrieval, invalidation, and synchronization between the two backends, using last write timestamps to ensure cache consistency.

classes.name: ChainedFastBackend
classes.description: A cache backend class that chains a fast and a consistent cache backend, managing cache coherence and performance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the chained cache backend with a consistent backend, a fast backend, and a cache bin identifier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by its ID, using getMultiple internally.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items, validating and updating fast cache based on last write timestamps.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item in the consistent backend and marks the fast cache as outdated.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple cache items in the consistent backend and marks the fast cache as outdated.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item from the consistent backend and marks the cache as outdated.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items from the consistent backend and marks the cache as outdated.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all cache items from the consistent backend and marks the cache as outdated.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by ID.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates cache items associated with specific tags in both backends if supported.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates all cache items in the consistent backend and marks cache as outdated.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on both backends.

methods.name: removeBin
methods.description: Removes cache bins from both backends.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the last write timestamp to NULL.

methods.name: getLastWriteTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last write timestamp, fetching from the backend if not already loaded.

methods.name: markAsOutdated
methods.description: Updates the last write timestamp and marks the fast cache as outdated.
